تستبعدون (form X)
# تَسْتَبْعِدُونَ (tastabʕidūna) /tas.tab.ʕi.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَبْعَدَ (istabʕada)
# تُسْتَبْعَدُونَ (tustabʕadūna) /tus.tab.ʕa.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَبْعَدَ (istabʕada)
